articles.title: Fat Bear Week: Vote for the Chubbiest Champ!
articles.summary: Every fall, people around the world vote for the fattest brown bear in Alaska's Katmai National Park. This year, 16 bears are competing — including a dad who broke his jaw and a mom raising three cubs.

articles.title: 16-Year-Old Guitar Star Nene Royal Wins America's Got Talent
articles.summary: A shy 16-year-old from Thailand picked up her electric guitar on America's Got Talent and shredded so hard the crowd stood up. Now she's the first Thai winner — and a million dollars richer.

articles.title: The Simpsons Season 38: Children's Books, Chimps, and Horror Cups
articles.summary: The Simpsons is back for Season 38 with a premiere that parodies children's books. Guest star Emma Thompson plays a wild author who gets drunk at the airport — and Homer has to get her to school on time.
